scope: Retirement collection: supplementary primary references, separate from the 24-record Timmer corpus. Dates below are access dates, not publication dates. Plan-specific rules must come from supplied plan documents.

sources.title: Retirement topics — Vesting
sources.observation: Employee elective contributions are owned by the employee. Employer vesting and service-credit rules depend on the plan. Separate ownership from withdrawal eligibility.

sources.title: Types of Retirement Plans
sources.observation: Distinguishes an account funded by contributions and investment results from a defined benefit promise. A salary-and-service formula is one example, not a universal pension formula.

sources.title: Compound Interest Calculator
sources.observation: Makes the starting amount, periodic contribution, time and assumed interest explicit. Inspires editable scenario inputs; no performance forecast is supplied by this library.
